newsitem.title: USA: RR Donnelley unveils new muni services.
newsitem.headline: RR Donnelley unveils new muni services.

text.p: RR Donnelley & Sons Co said Friday its RR Donnelley Financial unit unveiled new subscription-based services for municipal bond investors, analysts, underwriters and issuers.

Municipal.com, formerly called the Municipal Resource Center, hosts an SEC Nationally Recognized Municipal Securities Information Repository of official statements, annual financial information, and notices of material events.
Access will be provided through either an economy $99 a month fee, or a broader standard service at $250 a month.
RR Donnelley said it will also will offer site licenses to large corporate users.

"Municipal.com is providing a valuable service by giving clients desktop access to a NRMSIR via the internet or a secure intranet," Stanley Spotkill, manager in the firm's municipal communications services group, said.

"Collecting paper documents manually from a corporate library invariably takes time, and municipal.com makes this same information available on-demand, day or night, at the click of a mouse," Spotkill said.
